request.style: English, Gregorian chant, Magnificat sung in alternation between a solo cantor and a schola of male monks, no instruments, psalm tone with a gentle reciting note, abbey reverb, luminous and calm, 64 BPM, sung in English
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
My soul magnifies the Lord
And my spirit rejoices
In God my Savior

[Verse]
For he has looked upon the humble state of his servant
From now on all generations
Will call me blessed

[Verse]
For the Mighty One has done great things for me
Holy is his name
His mercy extends to those who fear him
From generation to generation
